# Geometry Proximity

Finds the closest target point, splat centre or mesh vertex for each element.

`lfs.geometry_proximity` · Utilities

## How to use

Connect another geometry as Target. Distances use the coordinates of both geometries.\
This measures to elements, not to the surface between mesh vertices.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Target | `Target` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Target geometry containing points, splat centres or mesh vertices; an empty target reports an error. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Distance | `Distance` | lfs.float | — | — | Distance to the nearest target element, in scene units. |
| Position | `Position` | lfs.vector | — | — | Position of the nearest target element; ties choose the first target element. |
